The joint distribution for arvl_to_dcsn is assumed to be the product of the declared conditional distributions given their named parents and the source coordinates: y_n given (a_rd) by retiree_death:distribution:y_n; θ_n given (a_rd) by retiree_death:distribution:θ_n; y_n and θ_n are conditionally independent given (a_rd).
